name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Manager | Partnership Marketing, Brand Messaging & Cross-Functional Execution
summary: Marketing professional with 15+ years across agency, SaaS, and marketing operations, with direct partnership-marketing experience: recruiting, enabling, and retaining a network of resale and referral partners at a reputation-management platform, and translating brand voice into content those partners could use with their own customers. Builds messaging frameworks and positions products in competitive markets, working cross-functionally with sales, product, and delivery teams to keep output consistent and commercially effective. Comfortable managing multiple workstreams at once, from strategy to hands-on asset creation.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides, translating operational concepts into clear narratives for a business audience.
Draft direct-response copy, landing pages, and campaign assets, building reusable messaging frameworks and tone-of-voice guidance adapted per brand and vertical.
Conduct competitor research and keyword gap analyses that shape content direction and market positioning.
Run discovery with business owners to surface goals, objections, and market conditions, aligning messaging and program design to what surfaces.
Negotiate and scope expanded engagements inside an existing client base, coordinating with client-side commercial stakeholders on program design.
Build performance dashboards and report results with recommendations to owner-level stakeholders on a regular cadence.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated marketing strategy across paid media, inbound, and content, coordinating messaging and execution across internal departments.
Produced conversion-focused campaign assets, including landing pages, email sequences, and copy tested against performance data.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Owned partner-facing marketing for a network of 15-20 reseller and referral partners across health, home services, and retail verticals (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Built partner communication workflows, content toolkits, and automated product-training sequences that gave partners consistent, on-brand material to sell with.
Advised partners on positioning and customer messaging, equipping them to communicate product value clearly to their own end customers - a B2B2C dynamic close to a partner-led growth model.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to identify engagement gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to route structured, high-priority customer feedback into roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance at a performance marketing agency and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Ran client accounts end to end, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Drove team initiatives for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, training, and sales training for tenured account executives.
Managed an e-commerce and multi-vertical account portfolio contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and messaging to improve client traffic and conversion.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, positioning technical capability against each buyer's operational problem.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for all but the final months of tenure, sustained while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
